name: Brimful Fist
description: Fill the striking arm with blood to the brim and release the whole load in one straight punch.

name: Surge Slip
description: Surge blood into one leg and slip aside from a charge before the opponent shifts their weight.

name: Redtide Ward
description: Raise a rolling ward of blood-qi that surges toward whichever side the blows come from.

name: Riding Pulse
description: Ride the pulse of an incoming blow along the forearm and let it slide off the elbow.

name: Vessel Sense
description: Spread attention through the blood of the body to feel where it runs thin or pools from a hurt.

name: Arterial Hammer
description: Drop a hammer-fist on the big vessel of the neck or thigh so the limb below loses its strength.

name: Warming Current
description: Send a long current of warmed blood into a deep hurt to close it for an ally or the self.

name: Redburst Volley
description: Fire a volley of blood-charged droplets from the fingertips that burst like shot against flesh.

name: Heartflood
description: Gather the pulse of the whole body and loose it as a flood of qi that rolls outward and knocks back all it meets.

name: Lifeblood Mantle
description: Wrap the body in a mantle of circulating blood that turns blows aside and feeds strength back to the user.

name: Stilling Thumb
description: Press a thumb into the pulse point of the inner elbow so the hand beyond it loses its grip.

name: Vein Hook
description: Hook a thread of qi into a vein at the wrist and tug the arm off its line.

name: Sluggish Drag
description: Thicken the blood in the target's legs so each step lags behind the last.

name: Pinning Thread
description: Pin the target's sleeve and shadow to the ground with a thread that tugs back through the pulse.

name: Leaden Limb
description: Strike a limb and clot the blood within so the arm or leg hangs as heavy as lead.

name: Pulse Padlock
description: Lock the target's pulse to the user's grip so any move the target makes jolts through the chest.

name: Hauling Crimson
description: Pull on the blood of the target in a slow tide that drags them a pace toward the user.

name: Standstill Blood
description: Slow the blood of an opponent through contact until the limbs stiffen and the body stands nearly still.

name: Marionette Pulse
description: Seize the rhythm of a bound target's heart and jerk their limbs by it to throw their own blow.

name: Heartknock
description: Thump the chest of a faint ally to wake the heart and bring the breath back into rhythm.

name: Warmbeat
description: Rekindle a faint pulse in a hurt ally with small steady beats of warmed qi.

name: Clot Seal
description: Seal a bleeding vessel with a knot of clotted qi to hold the blood in an ally or the self.

name: Lifeline Probe
description: Trace the main vessels of a patient with a thread of qi to find where the blood escapes.

name: Kindling Rub
description: Chafe cold limbs of an ally or the self until the blood returns and the numbness fades.

name: Guarding Hands
description: Cup both hands over a patient and thicken the air with qi to turn aside a stray blow.

name: Transfusion Flow
description: Pass the user's own blood-qi to a drained ally through joined hands to refill their body.

name: Venom Draw
description: Draw venom out of the blood of an ally or the self through the wound it entered by.

name: Curse Wring
description: Wring a lingering curse out of a patient's blood with firm slow strokes along the vessels.

name: Feverdraw
description: Cool a raging fever by drawing the heat and the taint out through the palms of the healer.

name: Heart Restart
description: Strike the chest and fire a pulse of qi into a heart stopped only moments ago to start it beating again.

name: Lifeblood Torrent
description: Pour a torrent of the healer's own vital blood-qi into a grievously wounded ally to close their wounds.

name: Twin Fist
description: Throw both fists as one matched blow with the pulse of each arm beating together.

name: Dual Throb
description: Beat two quick pulses in the legs and take two steps as if they were one.

name: Bipulse Guard
description: Hold both forearms in matched crossing guards thickened by the same beat of blood.

name: Paired Jab
description: Stab two fingers of each hand in a matched pair at two points of the same joint.

name: Doubled Beat
description: Hold one pulse in each hand and read two bodies at once or two points on one body.

name: Dualflow Strike
description: Drive a surge from each arm into the same spot so the two impacts meet inside the target.

name: Echoing Pair
description: Tie matching threads to both wrists so the target's arms must move together or not at all.

name: Paired Rupture
description: Burst two vessels at once with matched needles of qi so the target's pulse loses its rhythm.

name: Twin Heartbeat
description: Beat two hearts' worth of blood into one body for a single crushing strike with matched fists.

name: Doubled Torrent
description: Loose two linked floods of blood-qi from the palms that cross and crash outward over a crowd.

name: Warding Pair
description: Stand shoulder to shoulder with an ally and thicken one shared band of blood across both.

name: Backpair Brace
description: Brace back to back with a partner so two spines share the weight of a blow.

name: Mirrored Parry
description: Parry in step with a partner's arm so one thick pulse turns the blow for both.

name: Double Clot
description: Clot the blood at a wounded spot on the user and the spot of the partner at once.

name: Kinbeat
description: Link the pulse of the user with an ally's so their two heartbeats pace one another.

name: Pairshift
description: Step in unison with a partner so the pair shifts as one body off the line of attack.

name: Kindred Aegis
description: Spread one thick aegis of shared blood across two bodies that holds under a long assault.

name: Sibling Mend
description: Close the wounds of a partner by sharing blood-warmth through the joined pulse of both bodies.

name: Counter-Pair
description: Send half of a blow's force back at the striker through the partner's matched strike.

name: Paired Bulwark
description: Raise a bulwark of two linked pulses that spreads a heavy blow between both and returns part of it.

name: Joined Heartbeat
description: Pair the hearts of two allies so each draws on the other's strength and both guards firm.

name: Hawk Strike
description: Pounce with the hand curled in a talon and rake the vein at the target's throat.

name: Stoop Dive
description: Drop the body in a swift stooping step that closes the gap with the speed of a diving bird.

name: Raptor Pulse
description: Sharpen the senses on the pulse of a distant body and follow it through a crowd.

name: Talon Jab
description: Spear two crooked fingers into a pulse point with a hawk's sudden accuracy.

name: Wingblade Guard
description: Spread both arms like wings to brush aside a flurry of blows with thickened forearms.

name: Quarry Beat
description: Mark the heartbeat of a fleeing target so it can be followed and tugged back by the same thread.

name: Diving Talon
description: Drop from a high step onto the target with a crooked-finger strike that tears the vein.

name: Circling Pulse
description: Circle the target at the beat of its own heart and read when its guard will fall.

name: Hawkblood Dive
description: Fold the whole body behind one dive and strike a target's neck with a blood-heavy hand.

name: Azure Talon
description: Hook a talon of condensed blood-qi into the target's chest and tear it free in a single pull.

name: Vowblood Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries the weight of a vow sworn in the user's own blood.

name: Oathmark
description: Press a blood-mark on the target's wrist that tugs the arm toward the user's sworn word.

name: Vowline Step
description: Hold a steady bearing on the opponent and step along it without drifting off the line.

name: Oathward
description: Set a guard of thickened blood on a promise to stand and let no blow pass.

name: Oathbound Vein
description: Bind a vein of the target to the user's sworn word so the arm slows when it moves to break it.

name: Pledgebeat
description: Read whether an ally's pulse holds true to a pledge and slow the pulse of a liar.

name: Sworn Rupture
description: Drive a needle of vow-hardened qi through a vessel and leave the wound bleeding inward.

name: Pledge Brand
description: Seal a bound target's blood-qi with a vow so that they cannot gather force above a trickle.

name: Pledge Binding
description: Knot a pledge into the pulse of a sworn foe so that striking the user costs them their own blood.

name: Windrun Step
description: Run with the blood hot in the legs and the wind at the back in one long gliding stride.

name: Gusting Fist
description: Throw a fist in the gust of a running step so its weight rides the speed of the body.

name: Draught Parry
description: Brush a blow aside with a forearm moving as swiftly as a draught of air.

name: Breeze Pulse
description: Feel the pulses of nearby bodies carried to the user as if on a light breeze.

name: Windfront Guard
description: Face into the oncoming blow with a thickened shoulder to take it before it gathers force.

name: Bearing Jab
description: Hold a steady line and stab straight along it with a pulse-hardened point.

name: Trueline Surge
description: Drive forward on the line of travel and let the whole surge of the body land on the foe.

name: Blood Squall
description: Fling a squall of blood-charged droplets that rides the wind of the user's own movement.

name: Windflush Mend
description: Flush a wound with a cooling rush of blood to stop the bleeding of an ally or the self on the run.

name: Gale Heartbeat
description: Beat the heart to the pace of a gale and release the speed in one overwhelming strike.

name: Stormrun Blood
description: Run at storm speed with the blood roaring in the ears and strike at each pass of the foe.

name: Sworn Current
description: Pour a current of blood held to an oath into one steady straight punch.

name: Vowbound Stride
description: Take a long stride bound to a fixed bearing so the foot lands exactly where the oath points.

name: Oathblood Guard
description: Hold a guard under oath that tightens whenever the user is pressed to give ground.

name: Unadorned Mend
description: Close a cut with plain steady warmth of blood and no flourish on an ally or the self.

name: Bulk Sense
description: Keep a sense of the bearing of every nearby pulse and hold it as bodies move.

name: Vow Torrent
description: Loose a torrent of blood-qi along the bearing of a sworn word that cannot be turned off its line.

name: Current Fetter
description: Wrap a fetter of running blood around a target and hold it fast along the line of the oath.

name: Pledged Mend
description: Heal a sworn companion by lending blood-warmth that cannot leave the wound until it has closed.

name: Unwalled Heart
description: Hold the chest open and bare with a sworn pulse so firm no charge can shake the user.

name: Sworn Flood
description: Loose a flood of blood-qi sworn to a bearing that sweeps along it and shoves down all in its path.
